sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.zh: 我最后一条TikTok视频。

sentences.en: It has been fun here.

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Well, guys, this might be the end of an era.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，这可能是一个时代的终结。

sentences.en: Over the past few weeks, users of the popular video app TikTok braced themselves.
sentences.zh: 在过去几周里，热门视频应用TikTok的用户们一直在做心理准备。

sentences.en: I made so many friends and memories on here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里结识了许多朋友，留下了许多回忆。

sentences.en: I'm going to miss you guys so much.
sentences.zh: 我会非常想念你们的。

sentences.en: And I'm really going to miss it.
sentences.zh: 我真的会很怀念它。

sentences.en: And I'm really going to miss you.
sentences.zh: 我真的会很想念你们。

sentences.en: For a national ban to take effect.
sentences.zh: 等待全国性禁令生效。

sentences.en: This weekend, it did.
sentences.zh: 这个周末，禁令生效了。

sentences.en: And the app went dark.
sentences.zh: 应用也随之下线了。

sentences.en: Say bye.
sentences.zh: 说再见吧。

sentences.en: Hopefully we have a miracle and we get to keep TikTok, but it's not looking good for us.
sentences.zh: 希望我们能有奇迹，能保住TikTok，但目前情况对我们不利。

sentences.en: But less than 24 hours later, it came back, crediting Donald Trump with flicking the switch.
sentences.zh: 但不到24小时后，它又恢复了，并归功于唐纳德·特朗普按下了开关。

sentences.en: Thank you, soon-to-be President Trump.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，即将上任的特朗普总统。

sentences.en: I know I'm happy to be back.
sentences.zh: 我知道我很高兴能回来。

sentences.en: I'm sure a lot of you guys are as well.
sentences.zh: 我相信你们很多人也一样。

sentences.en: I love you guys and I will see you in the next one.
sentences.zh: 我爱你们，我们下期再见。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Sapna Maheshwari, on the biggest social media ban in American history.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事萨普娜·马赫什瓦里将讲述美国历史上最大的社交媒体禁令。

sentences.en: And whether Trump can actually stop it.
sentences.zh: 以及特朗普是否真的能阻止它。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月20日，星期一。

sentences.en: Sapna, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 萨普娜，欢迎回到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: So we're talking on Sunday afternoon, and this morning, millions of Americans woke up to find that TikTok, the video platform with 170 million users, was no longer working.
sentences.zh: 我们是在周日下午录制的，今天早上，数百万美国人醒来发现TikTok——这个拥有1.7亿用户的视频平台——已经无法使用了。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国政府谈论了几个月的禁令终于到来了。

sentences.en: government ban that's been talked about for months was finally here.
sentences.zh: 美国政府谈论了几个月的禁令终于到来了。

sentences.en: But then, as we were preparing to tape this episode with you, the app went back online.
sentences.zh: 但就在我们准备和你录制这期节目时，应用又恢复上线了。

sentences.en: You are a TikTok expert.
sentences.zh: 你是TikTok专家。

sentences.en: Help us understand what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 帮我们了解一下发生了什么。

sentences.en: So, yes, it was a huge deal last night when TikTok went dark.
sentences.zh: 是的，昨晚TikTok下线时确实引起了轩然大波。

sentences.en: It stopped working for people.
sentences.zh: 它对用户停止了服务。

sentences.en: Nobody knew what was happening.
sentences.zh: 没人知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And you saw people posting tearful goodbye videos at firSt.
sentences.zh: 起初你看到人们发布含泪告别的视频。

sentences.en: Then you couldn't see anything.
sentences.zh: 然后你就什么也看不到了。

sentences.en: You saw the app store just start changing as people started rushing to this new Chinese app called Red Note.
sentences.zh: 你看到应用商店开始发生变化，人们开始涌向一个名为“小红书”的新中国应用。

sentences.en: You saw people posting to Instagram, on Instagram Reels, on Blue Sky, just turning to everywhere they could to share how stunned and shocked they were.
sentences.zh: 你看到人们在Instagram、Instagram Reels、Blue Sky上发帖，转向他们能找到的任何地方，分享他们的震惊和错愕。

sentences.en: Essentially fleeing the app because they could no longer post there.
sentences.zh: 本质上是因为无法再在TikTok上发帖而逃离该应用。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: It was like digital refugees just trying to figure out where do we go to post now that this app that we use so much is suddenly gone.
sentences.zh: 就像数字难民一样，试图弄清楚既然我们如此依赖的应用突然消失了，现在该去哪里发帖。

sentences.en: But then...
sentences.zh: 但随后……

sentences.en: 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 12个小时。

sentences.en: That's how long this lasted.
sentences.zh: 这就是它持续的时间。

sentences.en: Do you know how stressed I've been?
sentences.zh: 你知道我有多紧张吗？

sentences.en: Around 12.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 今天下午12点半左右，应用恢复了。

sentences.en: today, the app came back.
sentences.zh: 今天下午12点半左右，应用恢复了。

sentences.en: Take us back!
sentences.zh: 带我们回去！

sentences.en: But, yeah, if you haven't heard, we're back now.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果你还没听说，我们现在回来了。

sentences.en: Just ignore the last week of everything I've been saying.
sentences.zh: 别管我过去一周说的那些话了。

sentences.en: And people have been freaking out.
sentences.zh: 人们都快疯了。

sentences.en: They're really excited.
sentences.zh: 他们真的很兴奋。

sentences.en: And mind you, I slept through it.
sentences.zh: 而且请注意，我当时在睡觉。

sentences.en: But the situation is really fluid.
sentences.zh: 但情况确实非常不稳定。

sentences.en: We don't know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: We're talking early afternoon Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我们现在是周日下午，时间还早。

sentences.en: And when I wake up tomorrow, I really don't know what the situation will be.
sentences.zh: 明天醒来时，我真的不知道情况会怎样。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's talk about how we got here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我们来谈谈是怎么走到这一步的。

sentences.en: And I'll remind listeners that TikTok is owned by ByteDance, which is a Chinese company.
sentences.zh: 我要提醒听众，TikTok归字节跳动所有，这是一家中国公司。

sentences.en: It had tried to fight the ban all the way to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 它曾一路抗争禁令直到最高法院。

sentences.en: Tell us what happened.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们发生了什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So last year, Congress passed this law saying that TikTok had to be sold by ByteDance, their owner, to a non-Chinese company.
sentences.zh: 去年，国会通过了一项法律，规定TikTok必须由其所有者字节跳动出售给一家非中国公司。

sentences.en: And this law offered this deadline to make sure that ByteDance and TikTok did it, said it has to be sold by January 19th or some sort of talks have to be underway, or the company
sentences.zh: 这项法律设定了最后期限，以确保字节跳动和TikTok执行此规定，称必须在1月19日前出售，或者必须进行某种形式的谈判，否则该公司

sentences.en: will face a ban in the United States.
sentences.zh: 将在美国面临禁令。

sentences.en: And what was the thinking behind making it sell the company?
sentences.zh: 强制出售背后的考量是什么？

sentences.en: So for years, lawmakers have had these national security concerns around TikTok.
sentences.zh: 多年来，立法者一直对TikTok有国家安全方面的担忧。

sentences.en: They're kind of in two camps.
sentences.zh: 他们大致分为两个阵营。

sentences.en: One, they've said that U.S.
sentences.zh: 第一，他们表示，根据适用于中国公司的法律，美国用户数据可能会被移交给中国政府。

sentences.en: user data could be handed over to the Chinese government based on laws that apply to companies in China.
sentences.zh: 第一，他们表示，根据适用于中国公司的法律，美国用户数据可能会被移交给中国政府。

sentences.en: The other piece of it is lawmakers have said that there's a chance that TikTok could spread
sentences.zh: 另一部分是立法者表示，TikTok有可能在用户不知情的情况下向数百万美国人传播

sentences.en: Chinese propaganda to millions of Americans without their knowledge.
sentences.zh: 中国宣传内容。

sentences.en: And the government's had these concerns for years dating back to at least 2020.
sentences.zh: 政府对这些问题的担忧由来已久，至少可以追溯到2020年。

sentences.en: And this is the first time they really passed a law that was going to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 这是他们第一次真正通过法律来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And the company, as I remember from your telling, actually objected on the basis of free speech, that free speech meant that it should be allowed to continue operating.
sentences.zh: 正如我记得你所说的，该公司实际上以言论自由为由提出反对，认为言论自由意味着它应该被允许继续运营。

sentences.en: But on Friday, as you're saying, the Supreme Court actually decided against the company and upheld the ban, which, of course, brings us to the situation we found ourselves in.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，周五最高法院实际上做出了不利于该公司的裁决，并维持了禁令，这当然导致了我们今天早上所处的局面。

sentences.en: This morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: TikTok said from when this legislation was first introduced that they would beat it, that it was unconstitutional, that it violated the free speech rights of TikTok users in
sentences.zh: TikTok从这项立法首次提出时就表示他们会胜诉，称其违宪，侵犯了美国TikTok用户的言论自由权，

sentences.en: America, and they gambled all the way to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 他们一路赌到了最高法院。

sentences.en: And astoundingly, the Supreme Court decided on Friday unanimously that the government had the right to implement this law and to ban TikTok if it didn't sell.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊的是，最高法院周五一致裁定，政府有权实施该法律，并在TikTok不出售的情况下将其封禁。

sentences.en: And so what happened after the court made that decision?
sentences.zh: 那么在法院做出裁决后发生了什么？

sentences.en: The court comes out with this decision on Friday, January 17th.
sentences.zh: 法院在1月17日星期五发布了这项裁决。

sentences.en: This law is supposed to go into effect two days later on January 19th.
sentences.zh: 这项法律原定于两天后的1月19日生效。

sentences.en: So Saturday night, users of TikTok start seeing this pop-up message appear.
sentences.zh: 所以周六晚上，TikTok用户开始看到这个弹出消息。

sentences.en: And it says that specifically, we are fortunate that President Trump has indicated that he will work with us on a solution.
sentences.zh: 它明确表示，我们很幸运，特朗普总统已表示他将与我们合作寻找解决方案。

sentences.en: So TikTok is saying that Trump is going to fix their situation, which is kind of confusing because Trump was against TikTok in his first administration.
sentences.zh: 所以TikTok在说特朗普会解决他们的困境，这有点令人困惑，因为特朗普在第一任期内是反对TikTok的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is a complete turnaround from how Trump felt about TikTok in 2020.
sentences.zh: 这与特朗普在2020年对TikTok的态度完全相反。

sentences.en: We're looking at TikTok.
sentences.zh: 我们正在审视TikTok。

sentences.en: We may be banning TikTok.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会封禁TikTok。

sentences.en: We may be doing some other things or a couple of options.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会采取其他措施，或者有几个选项。

sentences.en: So if you rewind your memories back then, Trump was very anti-TikTok.
sentences.zh: 如果你回想一下当时的记忆，特朗普是非常反TikTok的。

sentences.en: And here's the deal.
sentences.zh: 这就是交易。

sentences.en: I don't mind if, whether it's Microsoft or somebody else, a big company, a secure company, very, very American company, buy it.
sentences.zh: 我不介意，无论是微软还是其他人，一家大公司，一家安全的公司，非常非常美国的公司，把它买下来。

sentences.en: And he said that it needed to be owned by American companies and he tried to ban it.
sentences.zh: 他说它需要由美国公司拥有，并试图封禁它。

sentences.en: It can't be controlled for security reasons by China.
sentences.zh: 出于安全原因，它不能由中国控制。

sentences.en: Too big, too invasive.
sentences.zh: 太大了，太具侵入性了。

sentences.en: And he brought up the same national security concerns that we've heard from lawmakers recently.
sentences.zh: 他提出了我们最近从立法者那里听到的同样的国家安全担忧。

sentences.en: They were really focused on the data.
sentences.zh: 他们非常关注数据。

sentences.en: He said Beijing could find a way to get U.S.
sentences.zh: 他说北京可能会找到方法从TikTok获取美国用户数据，这是不可接受的。

sentences.en: user data from TikTok and that was unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 他说北京可能会找到方法从TikTok获取美国用户数据，这是不可接受的。

sentences.en: So he wrote this executive order trying to ban the company, but it actually didn't hold up in federal courts.
sentences.zh: 于是他签署了这项行政命令试图封禁该公司，但实际上在联邦法院没能站住脚。

sentences.en: They said essentially he didn't have the authority to ban TikTok at the time.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上说他当时没有权力封禁TikTok。

sentences.en: But this idea never went away.
sentences.zh: 但这个想法从未消失。

sentences.en: And his efforts actually gave rise to this law several years later that we're looking at now that basically demands this sale or ban of TikTok.
sentences.zh: 他的努力实际上促成了几年后我们现在看到的这项法律，该法律基本上要求出售或封禁TikTok。

sentences.en: Okay, so Trump actually inspired the law we're talking about today.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以特朗普实际上启发了我们今天讨论的这项法律。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this law was inspired by Trump and the company was really caught flat-footed.
sentences.zh: 所以这项法律是受特朗普启发，而该公司确实被打了个措手不及。

sentences.en: It had been hearing talk of a ban for years and it had thought it was in pretty good shape heading into the new year.
sentences.zh: 它多年来一直听到关于禁令的传言，并认为自己在进入新的一年时状况良好。

sentences.en: They had fought back a sort of ban effort the year before.
sentences.zh: 他们前一年刚刚击退了一次类似的封禁尝试。

sentences.en: President Biden joined TikTok around the time of the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统在超级碗前后加入了TikTok。

sentences.en: But then this law passes and the company scrambles.
sentences.zh: 但随后这项法律通过了，公司开始手忙脚乱。

sentences.en: It's trying to figure out how to protect its huge operation in the U.S., its thousands of employees.
sentences.zh: 它试图弄清楚如何保护其在美国的庞大业务及其数千名员工。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国是其最大的市场。

sentences.en: is its biggest market.
sentences.zh: 美国是其最大的市场。

sentences.en: And they think of Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们想到了特朗普。

sentences.en: They think of him as someone who, despite his efforts in 2020, might actually be willing to go to bat for the company this time.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他是一个尽管在2020年曾做出努力，但这次可能真的愿意为公司出头的人。

sentences.en: But why is that, though?
sentences.zh: 但为什么呢？

sentences.en: I mean, Trump, again, we've said, was the original naysayer on TikTok.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们说过，特朗普是TikTok最初的反对者。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Trump had seemed to kind of change his tune on TikTok.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普似乎改变了对TikTok的态度。

sentences.en: He'd spent a lot of time in the past bashing one of the company's big competitors, which is Meta, which owns Facebook and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 他过去花了很多时间抨击该公司的一大竞争对手，即拥有Facebook和Instagram的Meta。

sentences.en: And clearly, President Biden was willing to sign this law.
sentences.zh: 显然，拜登总统愿意签署这项法律。

sentences.en: And the company was thinking, you know, maybe you should try its luck with a new Republican nominee.
sentences.zh: 公司当时在想，也许应该尝试与新的共和党候选人碰碰运气。

sentences.en: So they decide to go after Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以他们决定争取特朗普。

sentences.en: How do they woo him?
sentences.zh: 他们如何争取他？

sentences.en: So the big player here is this conservative billionaire donor named Jeff Yass.
sentences.zh: 这里的大人物是一位名叫杰夫·亚斯的保守派亿万富翁捐赠者。

sentences.en: He's a big Republican.
sentences.zh: 他是共和党的大金主。

sentences.en: And it turns out he owns about 15 percent of ByteDance shares.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他拥有字节跳动约15%的股份。

sentences.en: So he has this big stake in the future of TikTok.
sentences.zh: 所以他在TikTok的未来中拥有巨大的利益。

sentences.en: And we know that he had talks with Donald Trump at some point in March of last year.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他在去年3月的某个时候与唐纳德·特朗普进行了交谈。

sentences.en: Around that time, Trump goes on CNBC and he's got a different message about TikTok.
sentences.zh: 大约在那个时候，特朗普上了CNBC，他对TikTok有了不同的说法。

sentences.en: I could have banned TikTok.
sentences.zh: 我本可以封禁TikTok的。

sentences.en: I had it banned just about.
sentences.zh: 我几乎已经把它封禁了。

sentences.en: I could have gotten it done.
sentences.zh: 我本可以做到的。

sentences.en: But I said, you know what?
sentences.zh: 但我说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: But he's saying, you know, yes, I'm aware of the security risks, but it shouldn't be banned.
sentences.zh: 但他却说，你知道，是的，我意识到存在安全风险，但不应该被封禁。

sentences.en: The thing I don't like is that without TikTok, you can make Facebook bigger.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢的一点是，没有了 TikTok，Facebook 可能会变得更加壮大。

sentences.en: And I consider Facebook to be an enemy of the people.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为 Facebook 是人民的敌人。

sentences.en: And, you know, maybe there's another solution.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，也许还有其他解决方案。

sentences.en: And I don't want Facebook's business to really benefit from the loss of TikTok.

sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I hope the news doesn't keep going for you.
sentences.zh: 希望新闻不会一直让你忙个不停。

sentences.en: I hope you have some of your Sunday.
sentences.zh: 希望你还能享受一点周日的时光。

sentences.en: I'm not counting on it.
sentences.zh: 我不指望了。

sentences.en: TikTok is back.
sentences.zh: TikTok 回来了。

sentences.en: On Sunday evening, Trump took credit for the ban being lifted in a speech in Washington,
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，特朗普在华盛顿发表讲话时，将禁令的解除归功于自己，

sentences.en: D.C.
sentences.zh: 特区。

sentences.en: Can you believe what I'll do to win an election?
sentences.zh: 你能相信为了赢得选举我会做出什么事吗？

sentences.en: And we went on TikTok.
sentences.zh: 我们上了 TikTok。

sentences.en: In the speech, he bragged about his popularity on the app and suggested that the saga was now settled.
sentences.zh: 在演讲中，他吹嘘自己在该应用上的受欢迎程度，并暗示这场风波现在已经平息。

sentences.en: So I like TikTok.
sentences.zh: 所以我喜欢 TikTok。

sentences.en: I like it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它。

sentences.en: I had a slightly good experience, wouldn't you say?
sentences.zh: 我的体验还算不错，你说是吧？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的消息。

sentences.en: A ceasefire deal between Israel and Hamas took effect on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 以色列和哈马斯之间的停火协议于周日生效。

sentences.en: As part of it, three Israeli women were released from captivity in Gaza and reunited with family
sentences.zh: 作为协议的一部分，三名以色列女性从加沙获释，并与以色列的家人

sentences.en: members in Israel, the first hostages to be released as part of the first stage of the deal.
sentences.zh: 团聚，她们是协议第一阶段首批获释的人质。

sentences.en: The hostages were seen being handed over from the Red Cross to Israeli troops.
sentences.zh: 人们看到人质从红十字会手中被移交给以色列军队。

sentences.en: They then had emotional reunions with their families at an Israeli hospital.
sentences.zh: 随后，她们在一家以色列医院与家人进行了感人的重逢。

sentences.en: The start of the initial phase of the deal was delayed by almost three hours to 11.15 a.m.
sentences.zh: 协议初始阶段的启动推迟了近三个小时，至当地时间上午 11 点 15 分，

sentences.en: local time after Israel said it had not formally received the names of the first three hostages to be released.
sentences.zh: 此前以色列表示尚未正式收到首批三名获释人质的名单。

sentences.en: The corresponding release of 90 Palestinian prisoners, mostly women and minors, took place after midnight on Monday in the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 周一午夜过后，约旦河西岸相应释放了 90 名巴勒斯坦囚犯，其中大多数是妇女和未成年人。

sentences.en: In Gaza, Palestinians honked car horns and blasted music to celebrate and began returning to their homes all across the enclave.
sentences.zh: 在加沙，巴勒斯坦人鸣响汽车喇叭，大声播放音乐以示庆祝，并开始返回整个飞地各处的家中。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Eric Krupke, Diana Nguyen, Michael Simon Johnson, and Mary Wilson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由埃里克·克鲁普克、戴安娜·阮、迈克尔·西蒙·约翰逊和玛丽·威尔逊制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Brendan Klingenberg and Mark George, with help from Maria Byrne.
sentences.zh: 由布伦丹·克林根伯格和马克·乔治编辑，玛丽亚·伯恩提供协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Alicia Ba'itoup, Rowan Nemisto, and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 包含艾丽西亚·拜图普、罗文·内米斯托和马里昂·洛萨诺的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由 Wonderly 的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Erin Boxerman.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢艾琳·博克瑟曼。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，和我萨拉·凯尼格一起，讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的人们的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
